name: Institute of Space Technology (IST), Islamabad
_note: Weights from the official IST Undergraduate admission page, tab 'Merit Determination Criteria', read in the owner's Chrome on 2026-11-05 (ugadmission.ist.edu.pk returns 502 to the container). Eligibility and seats from the 'General Eligibility' tab, accepted tests from the 'Entry Test' tab (Fall 2026 intake). A-Level computing/science applicants: Matric/equivalent 100% (no calculator needed, not stored). IST shows each applicant's status after login on eportal.ist.edu.pk and publishes no program-wise closing merit, so merit is empty.

eligibility.applies_to: BS engineering programs (Aerospace, Electrical, Metallurgy and Materials, Mechanical, Avionics)
eligibility.label: Matric (Science) marks needed for IST engineering
eligibility.source_note: General Eligibility (Fall 2026), each engineering program: Matric/Equivalent Certificate (Science) with minimum 60% marks.

eligibility.applies_to: BS engineering programs (Aerospace, Electrical, Metallurgy and Materials, Mechanical, Avionics)
eligibility.label: FSc / ICS / DAE overall marks needed for IST engineering
eligibility.source_note: General Eligibility (Fall 2026): FSc Pre-Engineering/ICS/DAE/Equivalent Certificate with minimum 60% overall marks, plus an accepted entry test.

eligibility.applies_to: BS Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and Software Engineering
eligibility.label: HSSC / DAE overall marks needed for IST computing programs
eligibility.source_note: General Eligibility (Fall 2026), CS/AI/DS/SE: HSSC/DAE/Equivalent with Mathematics with minimum 50% overall marks, or HSSC Pre-Medical with minimum 50% (two extra Mathematics courses). No entry test.

formulas.label: BS Engineering (FSc / DAE students)
formulas.source_note: Merit Determination Criteria, Engineering Programs, for FSc/DAE students: Matric/Equivalent 20%, FSc Part-1 or DAE (03 years aggregate marks) 40%, Entry Test 40%. Accepted tests (Fall 2026): NTS NAT-1E/NAT-1CS, HEC USAT-E/USAT-CS, NUST NET, UET ECAT, UET Peshawar ETEA, MUET and NED entry tests, ACT.

parts.label: Entry test score (NAT, USAT, NET, ECAT, ETEA, MUET, NED or ACT)
parts.hint: Weight 40%. Type your score and set the total to your test's total (ECAT 400, NET 200), or type your percentage out of 100.

parts.label: FSc Part-I (or DAE 3-year marks)
parts.hint: Weight 40%. DAE students: type your 3-year aggregate marks and change the total.

formulas.label: BS Engineering (A-Level / equivalent students)
formulas.source_note: Merit Determination Criteria, Engineering Programs, for A-Level/Equivalent students: Matric/Equivalent 40%, Entry Test 60%.

parts.label: Entry test score (NAT, USAT, NET, ECAT, ETEA, MUET, NED or ACT)
parts.hint: Weight 60%. Type your score and set the total to your test's total, or type your percentage out of 100.

formulas.label: BS Computing / Science (FSc students, no entry test)
formulas.source_note: Merit Determination Criteria, Computing/Science Programs, for FSc students: Matric/Equivalent 40%, FSc Part-1 60%. General Eligibility: no entry test for Computer Engineering, CS, AI, Data Science, Software Engineering, Space Science, Physics, Mathematics, Biotechnology, Chemistry and Remote Sensing & GIS.
